description: This is a test class for the EmploymentStatusService in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing methods of the EmploymentStatusService class including delete, get, save, and search operations for employment statuses.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmploymentStatusService, testing CRUD operations and search functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of EmploymentStatusService and populating test data.

methods.name: testDeleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests the deletion of employment status entries by mocking the DAO and verifying the delete method response.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an employment status by ID, verifying correct data loading from the DAO.

methods.name: testSaveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests saving an EmploymentStatus object and verifies the operation returns the same object.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests searching for employment statuses with filter parameters, asserting the correct number of returned objects and their type.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of employment statuses matching search filters.
